definitions.short: a cover ( garment ); figuratively, a veiling
definitions.full: H3682. kesuth כְּסוּת noun feminine covering — ׳כ Gen 20:16 3 t.; suffix כְּסוּתְךָ Deut 22:12 3 t. suffixes; — 1 covering, clothing Exod 21:10 ; 22:26 (Covt. code), Deut 22:12 ; Job 24:7 ; 31:19 ; of שַׂק as clothing of heavens Isa 50:3 in figure 2 covering for concealment, of Abaddon, the subterranean abode of the dead Job 26:6 ; ׳כ עֵינַיִם , covering of the eyes Gen 20:16 (so that they cannot see the wrong, figurative of a present offered in compensation for it; E).
